description: Demand and difficulty inputs for one App Store search term in one storefront: its demand (`demand`) and the related searches, the top results with their rating counts and whether the term is in their title, the strongest and median rating count among them, and how deep the results go. `thin` marks a term with fewer than ten results; `zayifEslesme` marks a term the store matches loosely. Free reads the terms the account tracks in that storefront; Pro and above read any term.
name: get_keyword_metrics
